en.title: ADAM-SusTrace
en.summary: Data pipeline and visualization for sustainability scoring across additive manufacturing processes.
en.challenge: Additive-manufacturing sustainability data spans materials, process steps, energy, and lifecycle impacts, making consistent traceability and comparison difficult.
contribution: Modeled manufacturing and lifecycle concepts as an ontology and knowledge graph.
Built Python data-processing steps for lifecycle and sustainability indicators.
Created a traceable prototype that connects source data, semantic context, and visual analysis.
technical: Process and material records are cleaned and aligned to lifecycle-assessment concepts.
Ontology and graph structures preserve relationships and provenance across manufacturing stages.
Python analytics derive indicators that can be presented in dashboards or reports.

architecture.label: Sources
architecture.detail: Material, machine, energy, and process records provide lifecycle evidence.

architecture.label: Data pipeline
architecture.detail: Python validates, transforms, and aligns heterogeneous records.

architecture.label: Semantic layer
architecture.detail: Ontology and knowledge graph connect products, steps, resources, and impacts.

architecture.label: Analysis
architecture.detail: Queries and visualizations expose traceability and sustainability indicators.

outcomes: Established a graph-first foundation for digital traceability in additive manufacturing.
Connected lifecycle assessment with practical data engineering and semantic modeling.
Prepared reusable patterns later applied in larger research and data-space projects.

zh.title: ADAM-SusTrace
zh.summary: 為積層製程的永續評分建立資料管線與視覺化。
zh.challenge: 積層製造的永續資料橫跨材料、製程步驟、能源與生命週期衝擊，使一致的可追溯性與比較變得困難。
contribution: 將製造與生命週期概念建模為本體及知識圖譜。
建立 Python 資料處理步驟，計算生命週期與永續指標。
打造可追溯原型，連結來源資料、語意脈絡與視覺分析。
technical: 清理製程與材料紀錄，並對齊生命週期評估概念。
本體與圖譜結構保存跨製造階段的關係與資料來源。
Python 分析產生可呈現在儀表板或報告中的指標。

architecture.label: 資料來源
architecture.detail: 材料、機台、能源與製程紀錄提供生命週期證據。

architecture.label: 資料管線
architecture.detail: Python 驗證、轉換並對齊異質紀錄。

architecture.label: 語意層
architecture.detail: 本體與知識圖譜連結產品、步驟、資源與衝擊。

architecture.label: 分析
architecture.detail: 查詢與視覺化呈現可追溯性及永續指標。

outcomes: 為積層製造的數位可追溯性建立以圖譜為核心的基礎。
將生命週期評估與實務資料工程及語意建模連結。
建立可重用模式，並於後續更大型的研究與資料空間專案中延伸應用。
